title: Lifecycle YAML parse and normalization
description: Use lifecycle schema registrations to parse MVP sections and normalize typed relations across lifecycle and architecture endpoints.
completion_criteria: Parse requirements, acceptanceCriteria, decisions, risks, tests, evidence, and relations when lifecycle is installed.
Preserve extensions/source provenance and preserve unknown plugin sections as inert data.
Resolve relation endpoints against lifecycle and architecture IDs with deterministic endpoint kinds.
success_criteria: MVP AC-02, AC-10, and AC-11 pass.
Core-only parsing produces a useful plugin-required diagnostic rather than silently interpreting lifecycle vocabulary.
